description: Authoring tool: generate a t-shirt-size ladder of bundles, then price it per cluster. Reusable — re-apply pricing when a new cluster onboards (final-plan-pricing.md §11, issue #33).

fields.description: The Plan Category these plans belong to; its builder decides authoring (ADR 0007).
fields.label: Category

fields.description: Resolved from the category — VM Rungs (vCPU ladder) or Simple (name + quantity + rate).
fields.label: Builder

fields.description: Resolved from the category: Server/blank authors plans, Resource prices resource types per unit.
fields.label: Provision Target

fields.description: The optimisation profile within the category; for VM plans it pins the memory ratio.
fields.label: Sub-Category

fields.description: Smallest rung, in vCPU (1 vCPU = 1000 millicores). The ladder doubles from here.
fields.label: Start vCPU

fields.description: Largest rung. The ladder doubles from start up to (and including) this.
fields.label: Ceiling vCPU

fields.description: GB RAM per vCPU; pre-filled from the Sub-Category profile but authoritative once set.
fields.label: Memory Ratio

fields.description: Disk for the smallest rung; scales with the size multiplier. 0 = no disk line.
fields.label: Base Disk (GB)

fields.description: Transfer for the smallest rung (0 = none); tune irregular tiers per rung below.
fields.label: Base Transfer (GB)

fields.description: Added to transfer per rung (base + index × step), e.g. +1000 GB each step.
fields.label: Transfer Step (GB)

fields.description: Generated plan names start with this (e.g. "Bundle 2 vCPU 4 GB").
fields.label: Plan Name Prefix

fields.description: One row per currency — the price of the smallest rung. Each rung is priced base_rate × its size multiplier.
fields.label: Base Rates

fields.options: Populate Rungs fills the table below from the formula; edit any value (irregular transfer, off-ratio memory, a hand-authored tier). Generate Plans opens a dialog to pick the cluster, currencies, and which rungs — then runs in the background, creating a bundle per rung and its rates. Re-run it per cluster (a plan is sellable on a cluster only where it has a rate, or a global one); blank cluster = global.

fields.description: Populate from the formula, then edit before generating.
fields.label: Rungs

fields.description: One row per plan: title, the category's resource type, included quantity, unit, and a rate multiplier (rate = base rate x multiplier).
fields.label: Plans

fields.description: Per-unit rates per (resource type × currency); a config is sellable only where every type is priced (ADR 0011).
fields.label: Resource Rates

fields.options: Seed Rates fills the table with every shipped currency × resource type so nothing is missed. Publish Rates writes these as Catalog Rate rows (per cluster; blank = global) and reports any currency still missing a resource type — that region can't offer custom configs until it is priced (ADR 0011).

name: Plan Configurator
